design_references.title: Distiller EPUB fidelity
design_references.claim: Compare source-linked PDF reconstruction and reader output against local Indra and Marker extraction plus common Pandoc packaging.

hypothesis: Distiller retains more frozen source witnesses in readable EPUBs than local Indra and Marker on the selected previously unused PDF.
null_hypothesis: Distiller loses important witnesses or fails conversion or reader acceptance, preventing a superiority claim.
independent_variable: PDF conversion pipeline on identical frozen source bytes.

environment.network_justification: Download pinned local OCR weights from official model hosts; Distiller alone sends the public source to its existing OpenRouter model. Indra/Marker receive no credentials. No external model calls for competitor pipelines.

parameters.distiller: cold reconstruction cache per repetition; adaptive owned-page source packets; low reasoning draft/source-review and bounded join-only compound review
parameters.indra: auto, math enabled, cores4; package-default text reading order
parameters.marker: fast mode recommended for CPU/MPS; no optional remote LLM

variants.name: distiller
variants.description: Installed Rust CLI; PDF-only cloud reconstruction, supplied common cover; no arXiv HTML identified.

variants.name: indra
variants.description: Pinned local Indra math-enabled extraction followed by common Pandoc EPUB packaging.

config.packaging: pandoc EPUB3, same title/language/cover; retain raw Markdown

variants.name: marker
variants.description: Pinned local Marker fast extraction recommended for CPU/MPS, followed by common Pandoc EPUB packaging.

config.packaging: pandoc EPUB3, same title/language/cover; retain raw Markdown

randomness.justification: Cloud routing and model inference cannot be fully seeded. Three complete repetitions per pipeline, no cherry picking. Weight/binary/artifact identities recorded. Missing runs/failures stay explicit.

metrics.primary: Per-witness source fidelity under frozen 32-witness oracle; component counts and unknowns, no summed quality score.
secondary: process maximum resident bytes when available; local-server memory limitations explicit
download/setup excluded from warm-model runtime but recorded
metrics.acceptance_rule: Report every terminal and every witness; no overall superiority claim if any important component is lost or reader acceptance missing. Do not change code/oracle after benchmark results; followup fixes need a new run identity.

evaluator.rubric: Frozen fixtures/oracle.json: inspect source wording, reading order, math structure, table cell relationships, notes, navigation and references. Full original-page images alone preserve visual content but do not count as semantic accessibility. Long noisy extraction does not pass through substring matches. Fresh source has no standalone figures; figure parity not measured. Grade failures and unknowns explicitly per repetition; sample reader independently.
